flows.title: See what a code change did to the map

steps.phrase: ask what the newer code did to the map
point the coding agent at the method in the coyomap clone
read the change-impact instructions and follow them
read the commit the map is pinned to
diff the pinned commit against the working tree, untracked files included
read the changed code and classify each change as modified, added or deleted
follow the map's arrows out to every element the change reaches
write the report, carrying the exact new text of every element it touches
leave the report on disk beside the map
steps.note: uncommitted until the person accepts it

steps.phrase: name every part of the map the change touched, and what each should now say

flows.title: Fold a change report into the baseline

steps.phrase: agree the report is right and ask to fold it into the map
point the coding agent at the method in the coyomap clone
read the accept steps and follow them
read back the new text the report already carries for every element it touches
steps.note: accept re-reads no code and infers nothing

steps.phrase: apply each was-to-now block to the stored map
write the corrected rows back into the stored map
stamp this accept session and re-pin the map to the code commit
read the commit the code now stands at
ask whether to commit the code first, or pin the map as dirty
steps.note: only when the code is uncommitted

steps.phrase: put the two choices in front of the person
commit the code, then say to go on
carry the answer back to the accept steps
write the build stamp beside the map
rebuild the code survey at the new pin
steps.note: only when the map already has one

steps.phrase: list the project's tracked and untracked files
write the code survey beside the map
commit the map, its readable view, the code survey and the report together
hand back the address that opens this project's map
give the person the address of the re-pinned map

edges.why: reads the pinned commit, and the map rows a code change reaches
writes the change report, one entry per element the change touched
reads the report's was-to-now blocks back when it is accepted
writes every accepted correction back into the stored map
writes an edited map back through the one canonical serializer
